title: Encryption at rest for data stores
statement: All stores holding enterprise data must enable encryption at rest.
remediation: Enable platform encryption at rest (TDE / SSE) on the resource.

title: TLS 1.2 or higher in transit
statement: All network endpoints must enforce TLS 1.2 or higher.
remediation: Set the minimum TLS version to 1.2 and disable legacy protocols.

title: Secrets held in Key Vault
statement: Application secrets must be stored in Azure Key Vault, not in configuration or environment variables.
remediation: Move secrets to Key Vault and reference them through managed identity.

title: Managed identity or OAuth for service authentication
statement: Service-to-service access must use managed identity or OAuth 2.0; static API keys are not permitted.
remediation: Disable local/key authentication and assign a managed identity with least-privilege roles.

title: WAF in front of internet-facing endpoints
statement: Internet-facing applications must be fronted by a Web Application Firewall.
remediation: Place Azure Front Door / Application Gateway WAF in front of the endpoint.

title: Security logging to the enterprise SIEM
statement: Security-relevant logs must stream to the enterprise SIEM.
remediation: Enable diagnostic settings and forward to the Sentinel workspace.

title: No shared or password credentials
statement: Shared accounts and password-based service credentials are prohibited.
remediation: Replace password authentication with Entra ID or managed identity.

title: PII masked outside production
statement: Personal data must be masked in non-production environments.
remediation: Apply dynamic data masking or synthetic data in lower environments.

title: Data classification declared
statement: Every data store must declare a data classification.
remediation: Tag the resource with a data classification label.

title: Customer-managed keys for restricted data
statement: Restricted data must be encrypted with customer-managed keys.
remediation: Bind the resource to a Key Vault key and enable CMK.

title: PaaS services reached via Private Endpoint only
statement: PaaS services holding enterprise data must disable public network access and be reached through a Private Endpoint.
remediation: Set public network access to Disabled and create a Private Endpoint in the workload subnet.

title: No direct cross-domain database access
statement: Applications must not read or write another domain's database directly; use APIs or events.
remediation: Expose the data through an API or publish change events and consume those instead.

title: APIs published through the gateway
statement: All APIs consumed outside their owning team must be published through the API gateway.
remediation: Register the API in Azure API Management and route consumers through it.

title: APIs are versioned
statement: APIs must carry an explicit version and a deprecation policy.
remediation: Adopt URI or header versioning and publish a deprecation schedule.

title: Cross-domain integration via API or event
statement: Cross-domain integration must use an API or an event; file drops and point-to-point links need an exception.
remediation: Re-platform the integration onto an API or Kafka topic.

title: Contract-first APIs
statement: APIs must have an OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contract.
remediation: Publish an OpenAPI 3.x contract and validate it in CI.

title: Async messaging for fire-and-forget flows
statement: Notifications and non-blocking flows should be asynchronous.
remediation: Publish an event rather than calling the consumer synchronously.

title: System of record declared per entity
statement: Each business entity must have exactly one declared system of record.
remediation: Nominate one system of record and mark the others as consumers.

title: Retention policy applied
statement: Data stores must define and enforce a retention policy.
remediation: Define retention in line with the regulatory schedule.

title: Lineage registered in the catalog
statement: Critical datasets must be registered with lineage in the data catalog.
remediation: Register the dataset in Collibra and link upstream sources.

title: Personal data minimisation
statement: Only the personal data required for the purpose may be collected or propagated.
remediation: Remove unneeded attributes from payloads and replicas.

title: Approved cloud regions
statement: Workloads must run in approved regions (West Europe, North Europe, UK South, East US 2).
remediation: Redeploy to an approved region or raise a data-residency exception.

title: Infrastructure provisioned as code
statement: Cloud resources must be provisioned by Terraform or Bicep through the pipeline.
remediation: Import the resource into IaC and disable portal changes.

title: Mandatory resource tags
statement: Resources must carry owner, cost-centre and data-classification tags.
remediation: Apply the tag policy initiative.

title: Deployed into the landing zone
statement: Workloads deploy into a governed landing-zone subscription.
remediation: Move the workload into the matching landing-zone subscription.

title: Content filtering enabled for LLM workloads
statement: LLM deployments must enable content filtering at standard or strict level.
remediation: Attach a content filter policy to the deployment.

title: Human in the loop for claim decisions
statement: AI must not make or finalise claim, underwriting or pricing decisions without human review.
remediation: Add an approval step before AI output affects a customer decision.

title: No external public LLM APIs
statement: Calls to external public LLM APIs are prohibited; use the enterprise Azure OpenAI service.
remediation: Route inference through Azure OpenAI behind the AI Gateway.

title: Prompts and responses audited
statement: Prompts and completions must be logged for audit with PII redaction.
remediation: Enable the AI Gateway audit sink.

title: Multi-zone deployment for tier-1 services
statement: Tier-1 services must be deployed across availability zones.
remediation: Enable zone redundancy for the service.

title: Backups configured and tested
statement: Data stores must have automated backups with a tested restore.
remediation: Enable automated backup and schedule a quarterly restore test.

title: RTO and RPO declared
statement: Every design must declare RTO and RPO targets.
remediation: Add RTO/RPO to the NFR section and validate against the tier.

title: No single instance for tier-1 workloads
statement: Tier-1 workloads must not run as a single instance.
remediation: Run at least two instances behind a load balancer.

title: Azure OpenAI
statement: Azure OpenAI is the approved enterprise LLM service.

title: Apache Kafka (Confluent)
statement: Kafka is the approved event backbone.

title: PostgreSQL 15
statement: PostgreSQL 15 is the approved open-source relational database.

title: MuleSoft Anypoint
statement: MuleSoft is approved for system and process APIs.

title: Java 8
statement: Java 8 is deprecated; tolerated until 2027 for existing systems only.

title: Oracle 12c
statement: Oracle 12c is out of vendor support and prohibited for new use.

title: SQL Server 2014
statement: SQL Server 2014 is out of support and prohibited.

title: Windows Server 2012
statement: Windows Server 2012 is out of support and prohibited.

title: Node.js 18
statement: Node.js 18 is end of life; upgrade to Node.js 20.

title: API-led connectivity for synchronous integration
statement: Synchronous cross-domain integration follows system, process and experience API layering.

title: Event-driven architecture for cross-domain propagation
statement: State changes that other domains care about are published as events on Kafka.

title: Strangler-fig for legacy replacement
statement: Legacy systems are replaced incrementally behind a facade, never by big-bang cut-over.
